semiconductor_relevance: High — Bronkhorst High-Tech BV specializes in precision flow and pressure measurement and control equipment essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Bronkhorst High-Tech BV provides advanced mass flow and pressure measurement and control solutions, including thermal and Coriolis mass flow meters and controllers for gases and liquids. Their products are crucial for accurate gas, liquid, and vapor delivery in semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Thermal and Coriolis mass flow meters and controllers for gases and liquids
